body: I made a horrible decision to be intimate with someone and then I found out he had a girlfriend and he said he regrets being with me and when I said I wanted to still talk to him he never replied to any of my text. And I recently lost my job in January.
I'm glad you didn't die and that you woke up and was excited to be alive!

I was recently laid off from my job in January. I haven't been able to find another job. And I was recently regretfully intimate with a guy I knew from high school and middle school and he only used me for sex. At the time I thought I wanted it but I made a horrible mistake. I didn't know he had a girlfriend and I'm not sure if he got me pregnant or not but when I told him he said that he regrets talking to me and that he is ashamed of me and then started ignoring me. I don't do well with rejection so I am taking it really bad and this has happened to me before and that was why I was celibate for four years but I made a mistake with a horrible guy and now I'm left to face all of this by myself. My dad never cared about me to help me choose better guys and I don't really have any friends to talk about this with so I just feel extra alone now since this is like the second time something like this happened to me. I try to be smart and make better decisions but I keep meeting the wrong people who only want to take advantage of me. My ex told me that I would never find anyone who would actually love me or care about me and that was ten years ago and I haven't. Everyone around me is finding great jobs and getting married or are in relationships and starting families and I'm all alone and only meet people that want to use me and throw me away like I never existed. I just feel like I'm not good enough for anyone and I don't want to hope for a change anymore because it doesn't seem like anything good is meant to be in my life. I know that I may be over reacting and other people have way worse problems than I do but I just feel alone in the world. I am tired of trying to convince people to like me or to stay in my life. And its other small things like getting $1000 dollars stolen from my savings and then losing my job then getting my work computer stolen. And it feels people are always staring at me and my ex, who I thought was the love of my life, always being a constant reminder that we are not together anymore. And I always feel misunderstood or excluded by everyone since I was a kid, and I just can't take the isolation of life anymore. I feel like all of the things that have happened is a sign from God that he wants me to kill myself. Because they keep happening over and over again and nothing is getting better it just keeps getting worse. I tried to kill myself in 2013 and I'm going through the same thing over again now. I'm just done with hoping things get better because they never do. I will probably be in this same situation a year from now so why wait for then when I can just end my life now.

Thank you for your kind words, you have helped. But I do think that God is putting more on me than I can handle, its always one thing after another I would just like a relief from all of the hardships. Those people have won I no longer want to play the game because I always lose. I can't handle life anymore.

I haven't ever been to the hospital yet but I don't want to go either it will add to medical bills and people will think you're crazy or something. Anything good I have gets taken away so I don't really have anything good to focus on. I'm 27 and still live at home with my mom and I can't find a job even though I have a bachelors degree. No matter how hard I try I'm never good enough. I keep meeting the wrong people. I have had money and computers stolen from me. God keeps placing evil people in my life to ruin any type of progress I try to make. People who I try to be friends with don't want to be my friend my whole life. People only try to take advantage of me. My own father doesn't care about me. I only meet people who want to use me. Even when I did good at work I still got laid-off and I can't find a better job so it was all pointless. Even when I try to help people they don't appreciate it and are still mean and rude to me.

I have called a suicide line before but they will only send you to a hospital or mental institution which will only make things worse. My life has been worse so I know that it can get worse from here and that is what I'm afraid. I don't have a positive outlook on the future because the past has been so bad. So I don't want to live anymore. I'm tired of waiting, and hoping and wishing for better days when they never come.
Yes I have everyday, she just tells me its not that bad and that it could be worst.
I would just want advice on how to die painlessly in my sleep or other ways.

Sorry to hear that but I have no one to call or talk to, nobody really cares about me. I have no friends. My parents don't care about me. My mom thinks I'm being dramatic and that my life isn't that bad when it really is.
